messages:
maria_cs: Kickoff for Sirocco private/VPC integration — short checklist and asks from CS. Hoping to clear network + KMS items by EOW. TL;DR: firewall rules, SAML role mapping, customer KMS key, and audit log sink to their SIEM.

devin_net: Got it. Can you paste the exact CIDRs we should allow and the healthcheck target? Also any proxy in path?

maria_cs: CIDR to allow: `203.0.113.0/24` and `198.51.100.0/26`. Healthcheck -> `10.10.5.12:8443/healthz` (from their NAT). No forward proxy expected.

alex_kms: KMS notes: we recommend CMK grants. Customer to provide Key ARN. Example grant snippet for us to consume: `{\"GranteePrincipal\":\"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/sirocco-priv-role\",\"Operations\":[\"Decrypt\",\"Encrypt\"]}` — we'll handle grant creation once ARN provided. Rotation window default is 30d; can extend on request.

sophie_eng: For IAM, we need a cross-account role trust policy for `redwood-priv-controller`. Sample: `{\"Version\":\"2012-10-17\",\"Statement\":[{\"Effect\":\"Allow\",\"Principal\":{\"AWS\":\"arn:aws:iam::REDCUST:role/sso-api-ops\"},\"Action\":\"sts:AssumeRole\"}]}`. Do they have an SSO group named `api-ops`? If not, ask them to create.

sirocco_ops: Quick question on audit logs — we want to stream to Splunk HEC over TLS. Do you support compressed delivery and backfill? What retention do you guarantee in Private?

maria_cs: Yes, we support TLS to HEC + gzip compression. Backfill possible via s3 transfer. Platform retention default for Private is 90 days; we can offer extended retention as a compliance add-on (pricing TBD).

devin_net: Action items: 1) customer to share KMS Key ARN + grant admin contact, 2) share Splunk HEC endpoint + TLS cert thumbprint, 3) confirm SSO group for `api-ops` or provide mapping, 4) confirm the two CIDRs above. I'll book a 30min config session tomorrow 10:00am PT to walk network/KMS steps — invite sent. :calendar:

maria_cs: Thanks — I'll nudge them for the ARN and HEC info. Note: customer mentioned retention as a blocker for their security review — marking a potential renewal/upsell conversation. Adding to account health notes. :memo:

opsbot: Onboard checklist created: `SRO-8472` — network/KMS/audit-logs tasks assigned to devin_net/alex_kms/sophie_eng. Due 2026-04-01.

maria_cs: Closing loop — will follow up post-config session with a short summary + next steps doc. If anyone needs pre-read, I uploaded the integration playbook link: <https://redwood.internal/sirocco/playbook|playbook>.
